lib/features/graph/ui.responsibility: Renders visual UI components, canvas viewports, and overlays for user interaction.
lib/features/graph/ui.exclusions: MUST NOT house domain state mutation logic, direct database/FFI calls, or low-level mathematical coordinate calculations.

lib/features/graph/engine.responsibility: Manages user interaction state (dragging, panning, zooming), processes canvas gestures, and drives the gesture Finite State Machine (FSM).
lib/features/graph/engine.exclusions: MUST NOT paint UI widgets directly or interact directly with the database or storage controllers.

lib/features/graph/presentation.responsibility: Manages UI-specific transient presentation state, view projections, layout strategies, viewport calculations, and theme mappings.
lib/features/graph/presentation.exclusions: MUST NOT directly mutate database structures or issue raw FFI commands.

lib/features/graph/store.responsibility: Coordinates in-memory lookup cache, spatial queries, FFI synchronization, and local reactive state updates.
lib/features/graph/store.exclusions: MUST NOT import, listen to, or depend on UI presentation controllers, style managers, or theme controllers.

lib/features/graph/models.responsibility: Defines UI domain models wrapping core Rust models, providing serialization/deserialization across the FFI boundary.
lib/features/graph/models.exclusions: MUST NOT import or depend on presentation-tier configuration parameters or metrics.

lib/infrastructure.responsibility: Handles low-level platform infrastructure concerns (logger isolates, uncaught asynchronous telemetry reporting).
lib/infrastructure.exclusions: MUST NOT import or depend on domain business logic or presentation-tier state.

lib/features/graph/models/graph_node.dar.srp_responsibility: Provides abstract domain model representation for all graph nodes.
violations: Line 8: Model imports presentation-tier configuration metrics (graph_metrics.dart).

lib/features/graph/models/graph_relation.srp_responsibility: Defines presentational relation models wrapping low-level Rust relation models.

lib/features/graph/store/graph_data_cont.srp_responsibility: Acts as the high-level orchestrator and Facade for domain store modules.
violations: Line 8: Imports and couples with presentation-tier ThemeController.
Line 23: Imports and couples with presentation-tier StyleManager.
Line 113: Constructor injection dynamically registers ThemeController listener inside store facade.

lib/features/graph/store/modules/graph_n.srp_responsibility: Performs optimistic node mutations and queues FFI command executions.
violations: Line 5: Imports and relies on NodeStyleStrategy from the presentation layer.
Line 8: Imports and relies on NodeLayoutStrategy from the presentation layer.

lib/features/graph/store/modules/graph_p.srp_responsibility: Performs optimistic entity property changes and text modifications.
violations: Line 6: Imports and relies on NodeLayoutStrategy from the presentation layer.

lib/features/graph/store/modules/graph_r.srp_responsibility: Performs optimistic relation creation and deletions.
violations: Line 58: Calls controller.styleManager.updateStyleForRelation, which leaks presentation concerns into the store mutations.

lib/features/graph/store/modules/graph_t.srp_responsibility: Manages graph template saves and instantiations.

lib/features/graph/store/modules/graph_s.srp_responsibility: Provides fast O(1) lookups for active in-memory nodes and relations.
Tracks dynamic element locations and performs spatial hash indexing for viewport culling.
Maintains communications and state streams between local store modules and the Rust FFI.
violations: Line 22: Contains an unused reference and parameter to presentation-tier ThemeController.

lib/features/graph/engine/interaction_fa.srp_responsibility: Implements InteractionContext to act as the unified facade bridging interaction FSM to controllers.

lib/features/graph/engine/interaction_en.srp_responsibility: Drives the Finite State Machine (FSM) translating viewport gestures to interaction states.

lib/features/graph/presentation/node_ren.srp_responsibility: Translates database/store truth into responsive view states and z-order layouts.

lib/features/graph/presentation/viewport.srp_responsibility: Controls viewport translation, boundaries, zoom constraints, and elastic viewport framing.

lib/features/graph/presentation/theme_ma.srp_responsibility: Coordinates active application UI theme state and bridges core styling preferences.

lib/features/graph/presentation/style_ma.srp_responsibility: Maps theme preferences and significance levels to concrete UI node/relation styling metrics.

lib/features/graph/presentation/workspac.srp_responsibility: Coordinates multiple tab sessions, handles initialization, and controls the active workspace.

lib/features/graph/presentation/view_sta.srp_responsibility: Manages transient UI-bound node states (hover, dragging, editing, focus).
violations: Line 42: Calculates node layout size directly in ViewState using NodeLayoutStrategy, introducing coupling with layout strategies.

lib/features/graph/presentation/strategi.srp_responsibility: Computes visual bounds and line-wrapping counts based on font sizes and configurations.
Resolves base node styles and defaults from global application configuration parameters.

lib/features/graph/ui/canvas/graph_canva.srp_responsibility: Constructs the layout viewport stack, listens to active controllers, and initializes the FSM environment.
violations: Lines 76-94: Combines inline query rules (gathering node and relation IDs) and dialog presentation directly inside the widget initialization block.
